name: hedge_hornbeam
form_origin: A MANAGED LINEAR FORM AND NOT A ROW OF SHRUBS: the stems stand in a line along the section's own run and the crown is the box the shear leaves — generators/GrowthForm.h's Cut envelope, which limits |z| by spread_m/2, |x| by run_m/2 and y by height_m. What is declared here is ONE SECTION run_m long; placing sections along a field boundary or a way is placement and is not built. Hornbeam is the German Formschnitt hedge and holds its dead leaf through the winter.
dimensions_origin: [SET]. spread_m is the CUT THICKNESS of the hedge and not a crown spread; height_sigma is small because a cut hedge is level by definition — the shear is what makes it so.
dbh_cm_origin: 0: a cut hedge stem is a rod and 1.3 m is inside the cut section.
lai_origin: [SET]. A clipped hedge is the densest woody surface in the set: cutting removes the leader and every cut end answers with several shoots, so leaf area per unit of crown volume is far above an uncut shrub's.
bark_origin: sRGB. Hornbeam bark is smooth grey and fluted; at hedge size only the grey shows.
